verdict.rationale: Gumroad's llms.txt documents OAuth plus MCP access that lets an agent draft and edit a product and publish it, and a public REST API for products. Every product gets a canonical short URL, which effectively serves as the payment link once published. Setting a price through the API or MCP is not stated explicitly, and no API reference or OpenAPI spec was reachable to confirm the single-session flow. missing for 10: explicit API/MCP documentation for setting price, explicit confirmation that a buyable link is returned on publish, a reachable API reference/OpenAPI spec, hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent completing the flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: OAuth + MCP so an agent can list sales, draft and edit a product, add the files and links buyers receive and a cover image, publish it, and check payouts for a connected creator
public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses
every product has a canonical short URL
